seoTitle: SForesight — Find SF Symbols by Meaning
metaDescription: Describe an SF Symbol in plain words and get ranked, copy-ready matches in seconds. A native macOS tool for Swift developers. One-time $9.99, no subscription.
heroHeadline: The symbol you mean, not the one you typed.
heroSubhead: Describe an SF Symbol in plain language and SForesight ranks the closest matches in seconds, then hands you the exact name to paste into your code. A native macOS app for Apple-platform developers and designers.
highlights: Search by meaning, not exact spelling
Copy-ready names for SwiftUI and UIKit

features.title: Search By Meaning
features.body: Type what the symbol should do, like "a play button for media," and get ranked suggestions that fit your intent instead of literal string matches.

features.title: Real Names Only
features.body: Every suggestion is checked against the SF Symbols catalog, so the name you copy exists and renders. No guesses, no typos.

features.title: One-Click Copy
features.body: Click any result to copy its exact symbol name to the clipboard. Paste it into a Swift, SwiftUI, or UIKit file with no retyping.

features.title: See It Rendered
features.body: Each match shows the glyph next to its name, so you pick the right one at a glance and keep your interface consistent.

features.title: Opens The SF Symbols App
features.body: SForesight detects the SF Symbols app, opens it for deeper configuration, or links you to download it if it is not installed.

features.title: Buy Once, Own It
features.body: A single $9.99 purchase. No subscription, no ads, no upsells inside the app.

howItWorks.body: Type what you need in plain words, such as "wireless connectivity" or "a settings menu icon."
SForesight ranks the closest SF Symbols and shows each glyph beside its real name.
Click the match you want and paste the exact symbol name into your code.

faq.a: It is a one-time purchase of $9.99 on the Mac App Store. There is no subscription and no ads.

faq.q: Is there a subscription or in-app purchase?
faq.a: No. You pay once and own the app. There are no recurring charges and nothing locked behind extra purchases.
You describe the symbol in plain language. SForesight interprets your intent, then validates every suggestion against the SF Symbols catalog so you only see names that exist.

faq.q: Does it need an internet connection?
faq.a: Yes. SForesight sends your description to a hosted model to rank suggestions, so you need to be online to search. It detects when you go offline and retries automatically once the connection returns.

faq.q: Which platforms and frameworks does it help with?
faq.a: The copied names work anywhere SF Symbols do, including SwiftUI and UIKit across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS projects.

faq.q: What macOS version do I need?
faq.a: SForesight runs natively on macOS 14.7 and later.

faq.q: Can I get a refund if it is not for me?
faq.a: Refunds are handled by Apple through the App Store. You can request one using Apple's standard "Report a Problem" process.
No. SForesight is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple. SF Symbols is a trademark of Apple Inc.
